notes.title: Eclipse update (2023-09-15)
notes.content:
In this update.

Firstly, the game "The Curse of Eclipse" had re-built and optimized using new game engine with c++ only. This is to improve the performance of the game overall.
Secondly, the rules of the game were changed to make it easier and more focused on explorations. Currently, the main character has the health bar besides the number of hearts, so that, getting hit by hostile objects or ghosts does not instantly kill the main character, but instead, reduces the health of it.
Finally, some minor changes had made to the interface of the game such as adding starting and ending messages and passwords to the levels.

enjoy the game.
